title: Plates
what: A second reconstruction’s continents, outlined over the first, and where its plates met: ridges where they part, subduction zones where one sinks under another, transforms where they slide past.
how: Continent outlines and plate boundaries reconstructed with pyGPlates in the model’s paleomagnetic frame: the outlines drawn as 0.25° masks, the boundaries as lines every 5 million years, each turned about the axis to line up with the surface map.
